summary: The filing is a Form 6-K by Huachen AI Parking Management Technology Holding Co., Ltd, reporting notice of a meeting of Class A shareholders and an extraordinary general meeting to consider increasing voting rights of Class B shares from 30 to 200 votes per share and adopting amended articles. The board recommends voting FOR the proposal. This is a routine governance matter—a proxy solicitation for a charter amendment affecting dual-class voting structure—not a special situation like an acquisition, restructuring, or other event-driven corporate action. No deal terms, premium, or price are involved.
